episodes.title: Take Your Daughter to Work Day
episodes.summary: With his retirement from the CIA imminent, Luke prepares for his next adventure, but revelations at home and an urgent matter at work upend his plans.

episodes.title: Stole Train
episodes.summary: Forced to team up in order to take down Boro, Luke and Emma realize their newly strained relationship is only the start of their problems.

episodes.title: Honeyplot
episodes.summary: The team goes from averting an international crisis to seeking sensitive intel in Moldova, where Emma offers to lure a target when complications arise.

episodes.title: Armed & Dane-gerous
episodes.summary: After receiving reassurance from Luke, Emma comes home to a startling surprise. In Greece, the team takes on a risky mission to break out a trusted ally.

episodes.title: Here Today, Gone To-Marrow
episodes.summary: Amid a devastating family emergency, Luke finds the lines of his double life becoming blurry as he deals with a distracted Emma and a demanding Boro.

episodes.title: Royally Flushed
episodes.summary: Barry and Tina infiltrate a private, high-stakes card game in hopes of inching closer to Boro. Emotions boil over when the team gets trapped in a bunker.

episodes.title: Urine Luck
episodes.summary: While closing in on Boro, Luke and Emma juggle relationship drama and a highly delicate situation. A life-or-death matter forces Roo to find a release.

episodes.title: That's It and That's All
episodes.summary: With the clock ticking, Luke and Emma make tough choices to finish the mission and stay alive. A big day for the Brunner family spirals out of control.

episodes.title: Fullest House
episodes.summary: It's a sink-or-swim mission when Luke and the team dive into deadly waters to stop a sinister terrorist from making a massive splash.

episodes.title: Highly Re-Greta-Ble
episodes.summary: A face from the past threatens Luke and Tally's recharged romance. The team breaches a fortified compound to keep vital intel out of enemy hands.

episodes.title: Tango and Smash
episodes.summary: As Greta attempts to loosen Luke's lips, the safe-house gang gets an earful from afar. Emma turns heads on the dance floor with an unlikely date.

episodes.title: Astro-Not
episodes.summary: While Cress tightens the screws, Chips matches wits with an interrogation expert. A stealth mission makes a bigger bang than expected.

episodes.title: Trippin' the Abyss
episodes.summary: Barry hitches a ride to the final frontier. As an operative's cover story begins to crumble, Luke and Emma seek help from an unexpected ally.

episodes.title: Penny Possum's Pizzapocalypse
episodes.summary: Emma and Luke catch a buzz in a deep-sea submersible. Back on land, bullets and breadsticks fly in a confrontation at a pizza joint.

episodes.title: Dam It
episodes.summary: Every second counts as the team scrambles by land, air and sea to avert a catastrophe. Aldon finds himself outnumbered — but not outmatched.

episodes.title: Let's Twist Again
episodes.summary: As the clock ticks down to zero hour, Luke and the crew must break into a top-secret facility before their adversary turns off the lights — for good.
